messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated restart rate detected for pods in namespace=redwood-inference-usw2 (count=18 in 3m). Auto-page to #incidents and oncall. :rotating_light:

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident opened: PD-4892; urgency=high; impacted-service=inference-runtime-usw2

sara: seeing a bunch of container restarts, exit code 139 on the runtime pod set. Pods keep coming back up then die within ~10s. :eyes:

alex: 139 = SIGSEGV, likely native runtime crash. Any recent runtime or kernel changes pushed to us-west-2? @mike

mike: pushed vllm-engine:2026-03-15-quant at 01:12 UTC to Dedicated pool B (rolling update). No other infra changes. Rolling windows started at ~01:10.

sara: grabbing logs from pod inference-runtime-7f8b9:
```
kubectl -n redwood-inference-usw2 logs inference-runtime-7f8b9 -c runtime --tail=200
[2026-03-15T01:18:01Z] runtime: initializing model cache
[2026-03-15T01:18:12Z] kernel: fused_attn_kernel.cu:+0x1ab SIGSEGV
[2026-03-15T01:18:12Z] runtime: coredump written to /tmp/core.7f8b9
[2026-03-15T01:18:12Z] watchdog: container exited code 139, restarting
```

alex: that line points to fused attention kernel. Can we get a backtrace from the core dump? If not, get gdb to print symbols quickly.

sara: copying core out now, and dumping quick bt:
```
# gdb --batch --ex "thread apply all bt full" /opt/runtime/bin/vllm-engine /tmp/core.7f8b9
#0  0x00007f8a2b1c4f1a in fused_attn::compute(float*, ...) at fused_attn_kernel.cu:412
#1  0x00007f8a2b1c3d9b in runtime::forward_model() at forward.cpp:128
#2  0x000055aa4b9f1c2d in main at main.cpp:78
Stack shows GPU kernel launch site in fused_attn.
```

jin: oncall plan: cordon + drain the problematic node(s) to prevent re-scheduling to same GPU; scale up new nodes with safe kernel profile. Who can trigger a temporary rollout to the previous engine tag? @mike

mike: I can trigger rollback to vllm-engine:2026-03-10-stable. Rolling back can be done in ~6 minutes. Will also add env RL_FUSED_ATTENTION=0 in the deployment to force the fallback kernel if available. Need a go/no-go on customer impact.

lucy: support sees ~12 customer sessions failing (5 of them high-priority enterprise). Error rate on hosted API +520% in the last 5m for us-west-2. Several customers reported timeouts and 500s. Customers on Dedicated capacity also reporting increased latency then failures.

carla: escalating PD to SEs for the 5 enterprise customers. Notifying account teams. Please annotate which customer requests were lost for postmortem.

alex: quick mitigation plan (in order):
1) Set RL_FUSED_ATTENTION=0 on runtime Deployment to force safe path.
2) If (1) insufficient, roll back image to 2026-03-10-stable.
3) Cordon affected nodes, drain, and reprovision with non-quantized GPU kernel profile.
4) Collect core dumps + first 100 request payloads for failing customers.

sara: applying env var now and rolling pods (kubectl set env deployment/runtime RL_FUSED_ATTENTION=0 -n redwood-inference-usw2). Restarting pods. :rocket:

ops-bot: Accepting deployment change: rollout started for deployment/runtime (namespace=redwood-inference-usw2). Strategy=rolling, maxUnavailable=25%

sara: post-change logs show fused kernel not invoked, runtime uses generic attention kernel. No immediate SIGSEGVs for new pods.
```
[2026-03-15T01:22:38Z] runtime: attention=generic (fallback), quantized kernels disabled
[2026-03-15T01:22:40Z] runtime: healthcheck passed
```

lucy: error rate dropping from +520% -> +45% in the last 2m. Affected customers' retries are being accepted now; we're still seeing higher latencies but fewer crashes.

jin: still cordoning node gpu-34, draining: kubectl cordon gpu-34 && kubectl drain gpu-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n redwood-inference-usw2

mike: starting rollback job to 2026-03-10-stable as a precaution; will hold if rollback not necessary. For now keep RL_FUSED_ATTENTION=0 until we validate a patched fused kernel.

sara: collecting telemetry for SLO/impact: requests failed (5m): 1,238; 95th latency increased from 210ms -> 900ms for a subset. No customer data exfil, just availability.

carla: created PD incident note with impacted customers, assigned to @alex and @mike for follow-up ticket (ENG-PT-742). Notifying CSMs.

alex: Can runtime team reproduce locally with the quantized fused kernel? If yes, we should create a minimal repro and test a hotpatch. If no, treat as data-specific or rollout-race.

mike: I can reproduce with the same model + quantized kernels on a dev rig using batch size 32 and sequence length 2048 — reproduced segfault in fused_attn with certain padding patterns. Repro steps saved to /eng/bugs/742/repro.md

sara: rolling incident summary so far:
- Root symptom: container exit code 139 (SIGSEGV) in fused_attn kernel after rollout of vllm-engine:2026-03-15-quant to Dedicated pool B.
- Mitigation: set RL_FUSED_ATTENTION=0 to force fallback kernel; cordoned affected node gpu-34; optional image rollback queued.
- Customer impact: ~1.2k failed requests in 5m window, 5 enterprise customers with transient failures, latency elevated for remaining requests.
- Next steps: reproduce, create patch/hotfix, staged canary test, postmortem with timeline and monitoring alerts tuned.

incident-bot: UPDATE: Auto-remediation rule applied: envoy-retry-window extended for 30s for us-west-2 routes (to reduce visible customer errors).

lucy: notifying customers that we have mitigation in place and are validating. Canned message ready, sending to affected accounts now.

carla: assigning follow-up tasks: ENG-PT-742 (hotfix fused_attn), ENG-OPS-191 (node reprovision safe-profile), DOCS-64 (runbook update for fused-kernel incidents).

mike: marking rollback on hold. Will push a patched quant build for canary tomorrow morning after tests.

sara: monitoring for 30m; if no regressions we'll move to close and schedule a postmortem. Thanks everyone for fast responses. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> waiting for postmortem. PD-4892 set to resolved=false; owner=alex; next update due in 45m.
